dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: The Lightkeepers were established to safeguard the freedom and peace of Nod-Krai. It was five hundred years ago that the Torchforger brought the first of the group together.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: That said, there were moments over the years when it seemed we might fade into history. Our troop strength has, in turn, been rebuilt time and again.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: But no matter what, as long as the light that symbolizes our will is not extinguished, we shall be reborn in flame anew.
